name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 22, 2012
06:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Harlan Dunn, member of Oak Hills Church
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring the week of May 20 - 26, 2012, "Public Works Week" in the City of Vista.
P1.
Presentation of Fair Housing Poster Contest Awards
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Levy of Special Tax for Community Facility Districts for Fiscal Year 2012/13 (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , levying a special tax in the City of Vista Community Facilities District No. 92-1 (North County Square) for FY 2012/13;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , levying a special tax in the City of Vista Community Facilities District No. 90-2 (Hacienda Drive and Buena Vista Creek) for FY 2012/13; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , levying a special tax in the City of Vista Community Facilities District No. 2000-1 (Hacienda Gateway Restructuring) for FY 2012/13.
C4.
Collection of Delinquent 2011 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for collection of delinquent weed abatement charges; and
2.
Set June 12, 2012, as the date of the Public Hearing to levy assessments on the 2012 property tax roll for collection of delinquent 2011 weed abatement charges.
C5.
Engineer's Reports and Assessments for Fiscal Year 2012/13 (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an Engineer's Report on the City of Vista Landscape and Lighting District No. 1 assessments for FY 2012/13 and declaring its intent to levy and collect assessments;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , determining the cost of services and the amount of assessment to be imposed on all assessable property within the City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1 for FY 2012/13 pursuant to the Benefit Assessment Act of 1982; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an Engineer's Report on the City of Vista South Melrose Landscape Maintenance District assessments for FY 2012/13 and declaring its intent to levy and collect assessments.
C6.
2011-2012 Citywide Cape and Slurry Seal Project, and CIP Amendment (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an agreement with International Surfacing Systems for the 2011-2012 Citywide Cape & Slurry Seal Project; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the Capital Improvement Program budget for the FY 2011/12.
C7.
Closed Circuit Television and Video (CCTV) Inspection Unit Purchase (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an agreement for the purchase of a Closed Circuit Television and Video (CCTV) Camera; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an agreement with North County Ford for the purchase of one truck chassis.
C8.
Recreation and Community Services Special Event Fees (CC)
C9.
Park Development at Vista Academy of Visual & Performing Arts - Acceptance of Grant Funds (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Draft FY 2012/13 Operating Budget (CC/BSD/CDC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Multi-Family Design Guidelines and Development Standards (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing and receive testimony regarding the amendments to the Design Guidelines and Development Code, close the public hearing;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the Design Guidelines for multi-family development; and
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2012- , amending Chapters 16.57, 18.34, and 18.35 of the Development Code related to multi-family development standards.
PH2.
Hookah Lounge Prohibition (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing and receive testimony regarding an amendment to the Vista Development Code related to hookah lounges, close the public hearing; and
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2012- , adding Section 18.58.610 to the Vista Development Code relating to hookah lounges.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
